skills.field_ambient: [Basic Cleaning] — You wipe down the nearest surface out of old habit. It gleams.
skills.description: Cleans mundane messes with supernatural ease.
Steadier hands with any blade.
A frame hardened by work and worse.
Everything behind one blow.
The next blade that finds you meets an answer.
A felled foe quickens the blood.

skills._comment: GH#90 rider: `applies.burning` (2 dmg/round tick, 3 rounds) -- a fire bolt catching cloth/fur alight is the direct fictional read, no reach needed. Enemy-exclusive skill (goblin_shaman T1 floodplains, rift_vermin_c T2/T4 rift_vermin_leak+trapped_halls_snare) -- no class grants flame_bolt, so this never touches player balance.
skills.description: A hissing dart of goblin fire.
A roaring lance of goblin-fire down the line.
A dart of biting cold that clings to the legs.
Woven mana drinks the blow before flesh does.
The first spell leaves the fingers before the thought finishes.

skills.field_ambient: [Light] — A steady white orb rises to follow you, throwing back the dark.
skills.description: A mage's first, faithful spell: a small orb of steady white light.
The feet decide before the mind does.
Breath returns, and the body remembers it can go on.
A cold prickle at the neck, a heartbeat before harm.
Thrusts that seek the seams in any guard.
A cut loosed before the guard can rise.
One bright line. The eye catches up too late.
Mid-swing, the blade bends its path toward whatever is unguarded.
Three points of pain in a single breath.
A wide, raking arc that finds an opening no straight thrust could.
For one moment the air is stitched with spearpoints.
A fist-sized spike of ice, hurled hard enough to crack shields.

skills._comment: Canon pass: renamed [Icy Floor] -> [Ice Floor] (id `icy_floor` UNCHANGED -- save-compat). CANON-VERDICT 2026-07-07: ATTESTED, Ceria Springwalker's spell list names [Ice Floor] directly. WIRED for real -- WISkillEffects.resolve_active gained an icy_floor resolver (area terrain state on WICombat.terrain, keyed by cell; applies `effect.applies` to every living occupant of the blast regardless of side, both on cast and on standing on/stepping onto an icy cell; purges at round rollover). effect_text.gd generates the real card line from `range`/`radius`/`duration_rounds` instead of suppressing it. See wi_combat.gd/skill_effects.gd doc comments for the mechanism.
skills.description: The stones glaze over, and footing becomes a rumor.
An arm's-length arc of fire, reaped close.
A snap of light and heat that leaves spots dancing in the eyes.

skills._comment: GH#71: the first blast_damage grant (fireball-class AoE). CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED, [Flame Pillar] ('Creates a circle of flames around the Target which then erupts into a pillar of fire.', ch. 9.14 VM) -- [Flare Burst] was checked first per the brief and is already a SHIPPED spell_damage skill (fire_mage L10, icon_flare_burst claimed), so this is a fresh name/id, not a reuse. AREA-SHAPE CONTRACT (must match icy_floor exactly, skill_effects.gd's `_radius_area` doc comment is the single source): Chebyshev radius 1 around the TARGET's cell (a 3x3 blast), wall cells excluded, occupied cells included, the caster's OWN cell can land in the blast when adjacent to the target [D: friendly fire is real, including self]. Instant damage only -- no terrain write, no status write, no expiry seam (contrast icy_floor, which glazes+slows for `duration_rounds`). Costs MORE than flame_jet's 2 AP/4 MP (a single-line skill) since a blast can hit strictly more bodies per cast: 3 AP/5 MP. No `icon` field -- `icon_flare_burst`/`icon_flame_bolt`/`icon_flame_jet`/`icon_flame_scythe` are all already claimed by shipped skills and no spare fire-blast art exists in `assets/ui/icons/`; twelve other shipped skills already ship iconless (mana_shield, quick_cast, counter_strike, battle_momentum, etc.) and `hotbar.gd`/`combat_hud.gd`/`field_hotbar.gd` all already degrade gracefully on an empty icon id -- disclosed as an ICON GAP for a future art pass, not a blocker. AI never selects it (WICombatAI only picks line_damage/spell_damage, see combat_ai.gd's own doc comment) -- player-only today, same as icy_floor/invisibility; `sim_combat_batch.gd`'s BUILDS array never assigns a `fire_mage` class directly (only bare `mage`), so this grant is unreachable by the harness regardless -- byte-identical before/after, verified.
skills.description: A ring of fire blooms at the target's feet, then erupts into a roaring pillar.
Mana runs down the blade until the edge sings.

skills._comment: GH#61: [Spellsword]'s L16 capstone (classes.json's own _comment on that class carries the full provenance trace). CANON-VERDICT: INVENTED, flagged -- [Spellsword] itself is attested canon (Pisces's 'dubiously qualified' hybrids; the wiki names Edward/Requiel as holders, both within the Book-17 bar) but no single clean canon Skill name/effect for the class survived wiki verification, so a restrained name matching the class fantasy (magic bound into a weapon strike) was used instead. Rides the EXISTING damage_mult type -- NO new effect type. Deliberately carries NO `weapon` key (unlike keener_edge's sword-only gate): combat_build.gd's `weapon_gated_kit` only filters skills that DECLARE a `weapon` tag, so an untagged skill fields for every equipped weapon family -- this is the one grant every real consolidated spellsword gets regardless of which parent line (swordsman/spearmaster) they came from. `mp_cost` alongside `ap_cost` is new for a damage_mult skill in this catalog (every other one only spends AP) -- a genuine capstone tax on both halves of the class's resource pool, mechanically inert elsewhere (WISkillEffects.resolve_active's damage_mult arm already calls the generic `spend_skill_costs`, which deducts MP whenever `mp_cost` > 0 regardless of effect type -- see that function's own doc comment). No `icon` -- same disclosed ICON GAP as flame_pillar/a dozen other shipped skills, degrades gracefully. Structurally unreachable by `sim_combat_batch.gd` (spellsword is never assigned in the harness's BUILDS array, same as fire_mage/ice_mage precedent) -- no balance-harness re-run needed.
skills.description: Every spell you have ever cast settles into the strike, and the strike remembers all of them at once.
Chores that would tire another barely slow you.

skills.field_ambient: [Basic Cooking] — You picture the dish this place is missing. Your hands twitch toward a ladle that isn't there.
skills.description: Simple meals come out right, every time.
Trays, kegs, and crates feel lighter than they should.

skills._comment: Canon pass: renamed [Observe] -> [Appraise Foe] (id `observe` UNCHANGED -- save-compat; ids are never player-visible). CANON-VERDICT 2026-07-07: ATTESTED, Skills Effect/A -- 'Provides limited information about another person', near-verbatim our mechanic. [Owl's Vision] was checked and REJECTED (attested -- Ridine's [Owl's Vision: Location] -- but its canon function is enhanced/night VISION, not a person-read; renaming to it would misuse an attested Skill). NOTE the quirk this Skill also reads friendly NPCs/props, not just foes -- off-label Skill use is in-register for TWI, and the Tactician-kit framing fits.
skills.field_ambient: [Appraise Foe] — You take in the empty space around you. Nothing here rewards a closer look.
skills.description: A measuring look that reads a room, a person, a problem, and files it away for later.
The whole field resolves into a map. You always know the one step that matters.

skills.field_ambient: [Soothe Clientele] — You offer the empty room a calming word. Only the dust settles.
skills.description: A word and a refilled glass, and the room's troubles ease. Patrons forget whatever was gnawing at them.

skills.field_ambient: [Unerring Aim] — You size up a throw out of habit. Nothing here is worth the toss.
skills.description: Whatever you throw finds its mark: a mug slid down the bar, a rag, or a troublemaker's head.

skills.field_ambient: [Sweep the Tables] — You reach to clear the dishes. The tables here are already bare.
skills.description: A cluttered table comes clean in a single pass, the dishes spirited back to the kitchen.

skills.field_ambient: [Server's Prescience] — You listen for what the room needs next. All quiet, for now.
skills.description: You know what a guest wants before they raise a hand: the empty cup, the missing fork, the order about to be called.

skills.field_ambient: [Charming Smile] — You flash a warm, easy smile at no one in particular. A passing sparrow seems charmed, at least.
skills.description: A warm, disarming smile that puts people at ease and turns a cold first meeting friendly.
A steadying word and a calming hand; the fight drains out of a foe, and their guard turns slow and uncertain.

skills._comment: The Awakened Raskghar's signature (enemy-only; no class grants it). A REACHING heavy swing realized on the EXISTING frost_bolt/[Calming Touch] applies-rider machinery -- spell_damage + the same `slowed` pool_penalty rider, NO new effect type. range 2 (a hulking bear-lion's reach) is deliberate: it is the only value that lets the boss's `caster` AI actually FIRE the slow under the shipped combat_ai.gd -- a range-1 swing makes the ranged AI kite-then-never-cast, a range-2 swing makes it maintain reach and land the maul every turn (task-a2 report AI-fit analysis). die/ap_cost balance-tuned via sim_combat_batch.gd BOSS_CELLS to hold the 0.6-0.75 Relc band; slowed pool_penalty is the shared status (WICombat._start_turn expiry, identical to frost_bolt). GH#90 rider: `applies.weakened` (2 rounds) added alongside slowed -- the maul batters the legs (slowed) AND saps the strength for the follow-up swing (weakened), a single heavy hit warranting two consequences. raskghar_awakened's ONLY skill, so the AI (`_act_ranged`'s spell_id scan) always picks it -- guaranteed real, no dead-code risk. Re-verified in-band, sim_combat_batch.gd BOSS_CELLS.
skills.description: A sweeping, reaching swipe of claw and forearm that batters the legs out from under you and leaves them slow to answer.

skills._comment: The frost field seam's caster skill. `freezes: true` is the ONLY tag the seam keys on (use_skill_field): faced at a freezable water cell -> walkable ice until sleep. Exploration-only (no combat/mp_cost), so it is fight-determinism-neutral exactly like [Light]. Canon rename: [Frost Touch] -> [Snap Freeze] (id `frost_touch` UNCHANGED -- save-compat). CANON-VERDICT 2026-07-07: ATTESTED, Ceria Springwalker + Az'kerash spell lists -- Ceria is our ice-mage adjacency exactly, and the utility-shaped freeze fits. `freeze_toast` overrides the seam's default cast line.
skills.freeze_toast: [Snap Freeze] — You lay your palm to the water and cold spiders out from it. In a breath the channel locks to grey-white ice, thick enough to bear your weight. It will not last past your next rest.
skills.field_ambient: [Snap Freeze] — Frost blooms from your fingers and hangs glittering in the air. There is nothing here for it to grip.
skills.description: A breath of deep cold that skins still water in load-bearing ice.

skills._comment: The burnable-prop field seam's caster skill. `burns: true` is the ONLY tag the seam keys on: faced at a prop tagged `burnable: true` -> the prop is removed permanently (removed_entities, saved) + a burn poof. Exploration-only, fight-determinism-neutral like frost_touch/[Light]. Canon rename: [Kindle] -> [Firefly] (id `kindle` UNCHANGED -- save-compat). CANON-VERDICT 2026-07-07: ATTESTED, Spells/F + ch. 8.43 -- '[Firefly] conjures a single mote of light that detonates'; a conjured fire mote fits igniting dry debris. No [Kindle]/[Ignite] Skill is attested ([Firestarter] is a CLASS -- Maviola El -- not a Skill, so it was rejected as a rename target).
skills.field_ambient: [Firefly] — A curl of flame dances up over your knuckles and gutters out. Nothing here will take the fire.
skills.description: A conjured flame, hot enough to take dry debris and old timber in moments.

skills._comment: The sneak seam, user-ratified stealth model. Canon rename (closes the provisional naming AND the real class grant): [Sneak] -> [Stealth] (id `sneak` UNCHANGED -- save-compat; ids are never player-visible, verified by grep -- no UI surface renders a raw id). CANON-VERDICT 2026-07-07: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- no bare stealth-walk Skill is attested, but the attested family [Stealth Arrow]/[Stealth Pause]/[Stealth Roll]/[Stealth Wing] (Skills Effect/S) establishes the [Stealth ...] grammar, and a bare noun passes the no-action-verb naming principle where '[Sneak]' (a plain verb) failed it. Now GRANTED by the earned [Rogue] class (gained_by `recovered_crate_watch`, POST-onboarding: that accomplishment is street-quest content, unreachable without already surviving the floodplains `goblin_encounter_1` ambush -- see classes.json's rogue `_comment` for the full trace). `sneaks: true` is the ONLY tag the field-hotbar toggle keys on (use_skill_field's `_toggle_sneak`), NOT this skill id -- pressing its number key flips `sneaking` on/off; `field_ambient`/`freezes`/`burns`/etc. are irrelevant to it (the toggle branch returns before any of those checks run). Combat read: `ap_cost: 1` + `effect: {type: move_pool_bonus, amount: 2}` -- a genuine self-targeted move-pool grant, ACTIVELY wired through WISkillEffects.resolve_active (see that file's doc comment for the ap_cost>0 gate that deliberately leaves the two PRE-EXISTING 0-cost move_pool_bonus skills, quick_movement/battlefield_awareness, exactly as unresolved/refused as before). Unlike frost_touch/kindle this IS combat-context, so it is only fight-determinism-neutral for scripts that never press it in a fight -- true of every canonical script today (stealth_loop and rogue_earn_loop both end before any combat begins).
skills.description: A soft step that slips past watching eyes and clears ground when blades are drawn.

skills._comment: The Mage line's second stealth verb, beside [Rogue]'s [Stealth] above. CANON-VERDICT 2026-07-07 (docs/design/k3-canon-verdicts.md): ATTESTED Tier-4 spell (Montressa du Valeross, Salamani, Ecleeif; [Greater Invisibility] also attested). FIELD MECHANISM (unchanged): `sneaks: true` is the ONLY tag the field toggle keys on (field_skills.gd's `use_skill_field` dispatch; tag-not-id, proven by test_sim_core.gd's synthetic `stealth_ritual` case), so this skill rides the exact same `WIGame.sneaking` flag/`_toggle_sneak`/`_break_sneak`/`_check_trigger_radius` skip as [Stealth] -- no sim code keys on this id, and this task never touches that seam. COMBAT READ (this task): `contexts` now also carries "combat"; casting self-applies an `invisible` status (`effect.type: "invisibility"`, self-targeted exactly like [Stealth]'s move_pool_bonus/second_wind's heal -- WISkillEffects.resolve_active dispatches it early, no enemy/adjacency/LoS gate). `effect.applies.invisible.untargetable: true` is the ONLY key any AI-exclusion or break logic reads (combat_ai.gd's foe-filter + _act_line's enemies_hit gate, wi_combat.gd's break-on-damage) -- DATA-DRIVEN, never a skill-id special case, so a future status reusing this flag gets the same treatment for free. `duration_rounds` stamps each applied status entry's `expires_after_round` (the icy_floor terrain idiom, reused per-combatant by WICombat._purge_expired_statuses, a small additive arm parallel to _purge_expired_terrain -- not a new subsystem). BREAKS the moment the holder deals damage (any attack or damaging skill resolution -- wi_combat.gd's `_resolve_hit`, keyed on the SAME untargetable flag, not this skill id) or naturally at duration expiry, whichever first. TRAP: area effects (line skills) do NOT respect this flag by canon ruling -- combat_ai.gd's line gate excludes an invisible occupant from the >=2-enemies-hit COUNT, but WISkillEffects._resolve_line_damage itself hits every occupied cell unconditionally, so a cast line still damages an invisible unit standing in it. Niche-utility costing (1 AP, 3 MP, 3 rounds) keeps this off the mage's core damage rotation -- WICombatAI never selects it (only line_damage/spell_damage are ever chosen, see combat_ai.gd's own doc comment) and PC autoplay is melee-profile (never casts spells at all), so `sim_combat_batch.gd` stays byte-identical despite the new live effect; classes.json's mage L5 grant comment carries the matching note. VISUAL (unchanged): `sneak_visual` is a presentation-only data key (read by world.gd's `_reconcile_sneak_visual`, never by any sim file) -- deeper alpha (0.35 vs the default 0.6 `SNEAK_ALPHA`) plus the shimmer treatment distinguishes this from [Stealth]'s plain translucency. COEXISTENCE CONTRACT (unchanged): [Stealth] and [Invisibility] both flip the SAME single field `sneaking` bool -- one stance, two keys. `mage_invisibility_loop` remains the field-seam canonical proof; `invisibility_combat_loop` is the new combat-read canonical proof.
skills.description: A working that bends the light around you until even a careful eye finds nothing worth watching.

skills._comment: GH#70 [Archer]. The power_strike twin, weapon-gated to bow instead of sword -- SAME effect type (damage_mult), SAME resolver (skill_effects.gd's damage_mult case), now range+LoS-aware via WICombat.in_weapon_range so this actually fires at a bow's range 4 instead of only adjacent. No icon: assets/ui/icons/ has no unclaimed bow/arrow art (checked against every skills.json `icon` usage before writing this -- icon_attack/icon_dash are the only two unclaimed ids, and both are reserved for the innate hotbar slots, not a Skill); degrades gracefully like flame_pillar/mana_shield/counter_strike and a dozen other shipped iconless skills -- disclosed as an art-pass gap, not a blocker.
skills.description: A full draw, held a breath too long, loosed dead center.

skills._comment: GH#70 [Archer]. The quick_slash twin, weapon-gated to bow. Same damage_mult resolver/range-aware seam as Power Shot above.
skills.description: Nock, draw, loose -- before the first arrow lands, the second is already gone.

skills._comment: GH#70 [Archer]. Reuses line_damage VERBATIM (flame_jet's own effect type/resolver, WISkillEffects._resolve_line_damage) -- an arrow that overpenetrates instead of a jet of fire, weapon-gated to bow instead of element-gated. NO new effect type. Friendly fire is real on this type by design (every occupant of the walked cells is hit, same as flame_jet) -- canon-fun for a piercing shaft down a corridor. Costed like triple_thrust (3 AP, no MP -- archers carry no mana pool; giving this an mp_cost would incidentally grant [Archer] a max_mp pool, which nothing in this class wants) rather than flame_jet's 2 AP/4 MP, since MP can't do any of the power-gating work here.
skills.description: One arrow, and everything in its path pays the same price.

skills._comment: GH#70 [Archer]'s field-flavor grant, the observe-family shape ([Appraise Foe]'s own field/field_ambient contract) reused for the archer's own read of a room -- the third-pillar (non-combat) presence every earned class carries (mage has [Light], rogue/warrior lean on their combat kit alone, but archer gets a bespoke flavor skill matching mage's precedent). Deliberately NOT the same skill id as `observe` (a distinct grant, not a re-grant of Tactician's [Appraise Foe]) -- no combat effect, exploration-only, contexts/field/field_ambient shape copied from `observe` verbatim.
skills.field_ambient: [Keen Eye] — You read the room the way you'd read a stand of trees for game: what moved, what didn't, what's worth a second look. Nothing here needs tracking.
skills.description: A hunter's habit of noticing: the broken twig, the wrong shadow, the one thing that doesn't belong.

skills._comment: issue #82's WINDUP SIM SPEC: the first `windup_rounds` skill. Declares on cast (WISkillEffects.declare_windup freezes the blast_damage-shaped target cells verbatim off _radius_area, spends ALL 4 AP -- the 'telegraphed AP spike' the original gap-analysis issue named), resolves at the caster's OWN next turn start (WICombat._resolve_windup) against whoever stands in the frozen cells then, not on cast -- EXCEPT the caster itself, excluded by id (F1 controller ruling: an adjacent range-1 declare always contains the caster's own cell and the melee AI never repositions, so inclusion was a guaranteed self-tax; allies in the blast are still hit). melee=true damage math there (STR-based, matching a construct's own basic Attack/power_strike) -- deliberately NOT blast_damage's own resolve_active resolver (that stays melee=false/INT-based, correct for flame_pillar, its only other grant). `windup_cadence` paces how often combat_ai.gd's melee-profile windup arm escalates to this over a plain attack. Enemy-only (vault_construct, data/combatants.json) -- no class grants it. GH#90 rider: `applies.rooted` (1 round) -- 'the floor itself seems to brace' already promises a ground-shattering effect; rubble pinning everyone caught in the blast for a round is the direct fictional payoff. `WICombat._resolve_windup` (its own bespoke hit loop, not `_resolve_blast_damage`) applies this on any hit that lands damage.
skills.description: A vast fist draws back, and the floor itself seems to brace.

skills._comment: Class-foundation pass R1 (#93/#95/#96, 2026-07-12): Tactician L5. CANON-VERDICT: display name SUBSTITUTED to an ATTESTED near-match -- wiki-checked (Skills Effect index) as '[Directed Strike]' first, no exact/close hit; the nearest attested candidate found is [Chosen Blow] ('The User can chose the angle and location of where their next blow attack hits, even if it's located around 30 feet away from them') -- a strong semantic fit for 'the tactician lands the opening he read'. Id `directed_strike` is PINNED (Lane B builds against it) and unchanged -- only display_name substitutes, the same id-stable/display-swap convention sneak->[Stealth]/observe->[Appraise Foe] already established. WIEffectText-expressible: damage_mult (basic_swordwork/power_strike's own type), no new resolver. Iconless (every sprites.json icon id is already claimed -- checked before writing this; see docs/VISUAL-LOG.md's new class-foundation entry).
skills.description: You read the opening before it's there, and the blow lands exactly where it was always going to.

skills._comment: Class-foundation pass R1: Tactician L7, a passive move_pool_bonus twin of quick_movement/battlefield_awareness (0 ap_cost -- the STANDING per-turn bonus phrasing, WIRED via WICombat._start_turn's existing `_move_pool_bonus_total` consumer, no new resolver). CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked (Skills Effect index, no exact/close match for 'Flanking Step'; 'flanking' IS used narratively as a real battle tactic in the story, and the positioning-skill grammar ([Steady Feet]/[Steady Ground] etc.) is attested, just not this exact phrase). Iconless.
skills.description: A half-step that puts you exactly where the fight isn't looking.

skills._comment: Class-foundation pass R1: [Strategist]'s L10 capstone (classes.json's own `strategist` _comment carries the full design trace: the plan's 'wider-radius observe' option was rejected as new sim ground, the 'dangersense-family passive' fallback was rejected as non-expressible -- this pass's own binding rule requires visible currency). `hit_bonus` (basic_swordwork's own type) reads '+10 to hit', a clean capstone distinct from L5's damage_mult and L7's move_pool_bonus. CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- no wiki match found; mirrors [Battlefield Awareness]'s own unflagged precedent (Tactician's L1 grant, same idiom). Iconless.
skills.description: The whole board resolves at once -- every gap in a guard, every foot planted wrong.

skills._comment: Class-foundation pass R1: Diplomat L3, field-only -- deliberately NO combat effect (the plan's own framing: 'its USE surface = the persuade-fork gates', i.e. future dialogue options may `requires`/`hide_when` gate on this id, the SAME `requires.skill` seam charming_smile/calming_touch/observe already use -- see wi-adding-a-class-or-skill's DIALOGUE-GATE COUPLING TRAP note for why this is granted at L3, not moved later, without re-auditing every gate on it). CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked, no match. Iconless.
skills.field_ambient: [Measured Words] — You turn a careful phrase to no one in particular. It lands, as it always does, on empty air.
skills.description: Every word chosen and weighed before it leaves the mouth -- the kind of care that opens doors a blunt tongue never finds.

skills._comment: Class-foundation pass R1: Diplomat L5, the pacifist's real combat contribution -- ally-targetable heal. CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED (Palt Fenrisol's own spell list names [Soothing Presence] directly). `effect.ally_target: true` widens WISkillEffects._resolve_heal (skill_effects.gd) + targeting_controller.gd's candidate list (self + alive_allies_of) + this card's phrase, ALL THREE together (see each file's own doc comment on the flag) -- second_wind (no `ally_target` key) is BYTE-IDENTICAL, still self-only. Costs MP unlike second_wind (a genuine resource tax distinguishing the two self/ally heals) and heals less (6 vs second_wind's 8) since it can reach a second body. Iconless.
skills.description: A calm that isn't performed -- it settles over the room, and over a hurting friend, the same way.

skills._comment: GH#90 support_skill arm carrier + guarded rider. Enemy-only (no class grants it) -- an escort-construct twin of [Soothing Presence]'s ally_target heal shape (WISkillEffects._resolve_heal, unchanged resolver), `applies.guarded` riding the SAME heal-applies widening this task added. AP-only (no mp_cost, a construct's ward isn't a spell) -- a small mend plus a defensive ward is the direct read for an escort construct covering its hurt sibling/boss. combat_ai.gd's NEW support_skill arm (`_act_guard`'s `_support_skill` scan) picks any known, affordable heal-type skill generically -- no name-specific wiring needed. First (and today only) holder: ruin_ward_b (data/combatants.json), asymmetric with its sibling ruin_ward_a (which stays skill-less, same asymmetric-pair precedent as river_wolf_a/b vs c).
skills.description: A muttered ward and a steadying hand -- the hurt eases, and the next blow lands a little softer.

skills._comment: Class-foundation pass R1: Diplomat L7, field-only flavor + a future vendor-perk hook (per the plan) -- `charming_smile` STAYS the L1 dialogue-gate skill, untouched. CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked (an [Open Says Me] door-opening spell IS attested, but its canon function is a literal magic word that opens a door/gate, not a social-capital idiom; misusing it here would be the same mistake [Owl's Vision] was rejected for on [Appraise Foe]'s own rename). Iconless.
skills.field_ambient: [Open Doors] — You offer the easy, practiced warmth that opens rooms. There is no room here to open.
skills.description: Doors that would stay shut for anyone else swing open at your approach -- goodwill has its own kind of key.

skills._comment: Class-foundation pass R1: Rogue L3. Field-only, reuses the SAME requires_skill+on_skill_use per-prop reveal seam observe/basic_cooking/basic_cleaning already use (no new field_skills.gd dispatch code -- 'radius 2' in the plan's own framing is flavor prose for a per-prop reveal, not a new area-scan mechanism, which would be real new sim ground outside this pass's scope). GENERALIZED per the plan: future trap-class props (R6, Lane B's parallel placements) point their reveal's `requires_skill` at this id; the EXISTING dart_slit_a/illusory_floor_a (8d, shipped) stay on `requires_skill: observe` UNCHANGED -- re-pointing already-shipped traps would REGRESS every non-Rogue player's existing ability to reveal them (observe is a Tactician L1 grant, reachable without Rogue at all), which is exactly the 'observe-based disarms stay as the no-Rogue fallback' clause in the plan. Id PINNED (Lane B builds against it). CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked (Skills Effect index), no match for a bare trap-sense Skill. Iconless.
skills.field_ambient: [Find Trap] — You scan the ground and walls out of old habit. Nothing here is rigged.

skills._comment: Class-foundation pass R2 (issue #96's own reported content gap, 2026-07-12): frost_bolt's fire twin -- the earn-surface fix for Fire Mage's structural under-40x throughput vs Ice (see docs/design/evolution-reachability.md's 'Structural finding 2'). flame_jet stays untouched (still the only line-shaped fire skill); this is the practical EARLY single-target active fire lacked entirely. WIEffectText-expressible: `spell_damage`, the same type/resolver frost_bolt/ice_shard/flame_bolt/flare_burst/flame_scythe already use -- zero new resolver. `element: fire` tallies BOTH `spell_cast` and `fire_cast` for free (wi_combat.gd's existing `_tally_skill_use`, keyed off the tag, not this skill's id) -- the exact counter mage's evolution.targets already reads, so this closes the gap STRUCTURALLY (a real, castable early fire option any player can reach for), not by retuning a threshold. DIE HONESTY: the plan's own framing ('slightly weaker die') cannot be a literal mechanical difference -- `effect.die` is VESTIGIAL (wi_combat.gd's `_resolve_hit` always rolls the CASTER's own weapon_die, never a per-skill die; see effect_text.gd's own doc comment on `spell_damage`'s phrase). The honest 'slightly weaker' reading is COST: 2 AP/3 MP vs frost_bolt's 1 AP/2 MP for the SAME range/die and no `applies` rider (frost_bolt also slows) -- flame_dart is a real, always-available fire option, genuinely a notch worse per-cast than frost_bolt, cheaper than flame_jet (2 AP/4 MP). CANON-VERDICT: family-attested -- no exact '[Flame Dart]'/'[Fire Dart]' hit on the wiki, but the '[___ Dart]' spell family IS attested ([Bone Dart], [Stone Dart], and directly relevant, [Ice Dart] on Ceria Springwalker's own spell list -- frost_bolt's exact real-world sibling), so generalizing the element from ice/bone/stone to fire is the SAME reasoning [Stealth]'s own _comment already applies to an attested family. Id PINNED (Lane B builds against it). Iconless (icon_flame_bolt/icon_flame_jet/icon_flame_scythe/icon_flare_burst are all already claimed by shipped fire skills, and no spare fire-bolt art exists) -- disclosed in docs/VISUAL-LOG.md's class-foundation entry.

skills._comment: Class-foundation pass R4 (2026-07-12): [Innkeeper]'s L14 grant. Field-only (no `ap_cost`/`effect` -- this is by design, not an omission: the skill's REAL mechanical hook is a small wage bump wired directly at the ONE existing renewable-wage resolution site, src/core/wi_game.gd's interact()-level `once_per_waking` gold branch -- `known_skills().has('perfect_hospitality')` adds +1 gold to any once_per_waking wage prop (serving_tray today; any future one gets it for free), NEVER a one-shot discovery prop like frozen_cache (which carries no once_per_waking key and never reaches that branch). Reuses the EXISTING `_apply_gold_effect` router -- no new economy mechanism, the smallest wiring the plan asked for. CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked (Skills Effect/P), no match for a bare hospitality-themed Skill. Iconless.

skills._comment: Class-foundation pass R4 (2026-07-12): [Ranger]'s L14 grant, the one genuinely new skill (dangersense is re-listed alongside it but structurally guaranteed already -- see the class's own _comment). MECHANICAL SUBSTITUTION, disclosed: the plan's own framing was 'bow damage_mult passive ~1.15', but `damage_mult` has NO PASSIVE shape in this catalog -- skill_effects.gd's own doc comment is explicit that `resolve_active`'s damage_mult case is ACTIVE-CAST-ONLY (spends AP via `spend_skill_costs`, requires a target); a 0-ap_cost damage_mult would let a player re-cast it for free unlimited times per turn, a real exploit, not a passive. `hit_bonus` (basic_swordwork's own type) is the nearest EXISTING passive currency -- genuinely a better thematic fit besides: 'steady' reads as precision/control, not raw power, so a to-hit bonus is arguably the more honest translation of the name, not just the mechanically-forced one. `weapon: bow` gates it through the SAME `weapon_gated_kit` filter every other weapon-tagged skill already uses, so it only ever contributes with a bow equipped -- the 'bow passive' framing holds exactly. CANON-VERDICT: family-attested -- no exact '[Steady Draw]' hit, but the '[Steady ___]' grammar IS attested ([Steady Feet]/[Steady Ground]/[Steady Hands]/[Steady Hooves]/[Steady Rhythm]/[Steady the Ship]), the SAME [Stealth]-precedent reasoning (an attested family, generalized to a new object). Iconless.
skills.description: Breath out, string back, and the point of aim simply stops drifting -- a drawn bow held as still as a nail in a beam.

skills._comment: Class-foundation pass R5 (issue #98, 2026-07-12): [Trader] L1's gate skill (the mandatory-first-grant convention every earned class uses -- mage/warrior/diplomat/tactician/rogue/archer all grant their signature skill at L1). Deliberately carries NEITHER `ap_cost`/`effect` NOR `field: true` -- a pure passive identity trait, the SAME shape lesser_stamina/lesser_strength already ship (flavor-only, never castable). The REAL mechanism lives entirely in src/core/dialogue.gd's `_priced_gold` (the ONE resolution site the gate/display/actual-deduction all share), checked by this id directly against the ctx skill list -- see that function's own doc comment for the full price_mod design (~10% off, floor-rounded). REVIEW-WAVE CONTROLLER RULING (2026-07-12): haggling is OPT-IN -- the discount only applies on a node carrying `haggle: true` (the vendor visibly entertains it); the game-wide DEFAULT is no discount, so new civic/shop content can never silently discount by omission. v1 carrier surface is deliberately THIN (Eloise's shop node only -- Krshia's own line refuses haggling everywhere, Pallass civic fees never haggle) and ACCEPTED as such: issue #92's vendor wave expands the carrier list. CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked (Skills Effect/B), no bare bargaining/haggling Skill attested ('[Basic Negotiator]' exists but is general diplomacy, not price-specific -- a misuse to rename onto).

skills._comment: Class-foundation pass R5: [Merchant]'s floor grant ('sell prices improve', the plan's own framing). Rides the ALREADY-BUILT `trade_bonus` seam (src/core/wi_game.gd's `_trade_bonus()`, its own doc comment naming this EXACT example before this pass ever wrote it: 'a future entry ({"trade_bonus": 0.1}) needs zero code once known_skills() surfaces it') -- `trade_bonus` is a TOP-LEVEL skill field (not nested in `effect`; _trade_bonus() reads it directly off the catalog record), summed into WIGame.sell_price's existing `floor(worth * 0.5 * (1 + trade_bonus))` formula. ECONOMY GUARD: the shipped sell_price formula's own base rate is 0.5 (50% of buy price) -- RATIFIED, shipped, tested content (item.gd's own doc comment) -- NOT retroactively changed to the plan's guessed '~40%' baseline (written before the existing mechanism was found; changing an already-live economy number for no functional reason would be pure churn, and risks unbalancing other already-tuned content that assumes 50%). bulk_terms adds +0.1 on top (55% effective), a real, modest, disclosed improvement. No `ap_cost`/`effect`/`field` -- same passive-identity shape as bargain above. CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked, no match.
skills.description: Wholesale eyes on a retail world -- goods move through you in bulk, and the numbers favor the one who moves them.
